item_name: Rothco Deluxe Low Profile Cap -Desert Storm Vet
item_short_desc: With its detailed embroidery and classic design, the Rothco Deluxe Low Profile Cap - Desert Storm Vet is the perfect addition to your collection. This baseball-styled cap proudly features raised 3-D embroidered “Desert Storm Veteran” lettering and ribbon on the front center, adding a touch of distinction and honor. The cap also includes additional embroidered “Desert Storm” text on the brim and “DSV” text on the sandwich brim for added detail.
description: With its detailed embroidery and classic design, the Rothco Deluxe Low Profile Cap - Desert Storm Vet is the perfect addition to your collection. Whether you are a Desert Storm veteran or looking to show your support, this cap is a meaningful and stylish choice. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
